newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrials end firm on futures,golds dip.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrials end firm on futures,golds dip.

text.p: After a slow start South African industrial shares ended firm on futures players returning to the market in noon trade. Golds were lacklustre, tracking a lower bullion price.
Dealers said institutions were watching proceedings from the sidelines occasionally coming in to buy or sell an odd share according to their needs but without a visible buying programme.
"It is absolutely futures-related. Obviously there are pockets of natural trade, where institutions see a share they like. But it was very quiet on the institutions' side," a dealer said.

They said afternoon trade was also boosted by the Business Confidence Index which rose 0.4 points in August to 117 points but the employment numbers in the U.S. were seen putting pressure on Wall Street.
Overall index was up 17.7 points to 6,789.6 points, the industrial index rose 26.7 points to 7.970.3 points and the gold index fell 5.6 points to 1,796.8 points.
